node.title: THE CORE, SHARPENED: multiplicative difference-designs (few bases certify everything)
node.statement: Construct at least B*/2^33 pairwise e1-distinct half-size subset-sum centers whose nonzero pairwise differences lie in height-budget units times a multiplicative semigroup generated by poly(N') bases, without consuming prefix-map fiber counts. || N11 STATUS RULING (2026-07-22, wave-20 ratified): demoted from the false-green frontier; the stated claim is an OPEN PROBLEM pending re-proof (banked implication proofs and the return-to-PROVED path are in status_ruling.md).
node.attack_surface: toy design search at small N' (measure |F| vs g achievable); cyclotomic-unit literature (the (zeta^k - 1) multiplicative structure is classical); partial designs = proportional window fractions
node.falsifier: n/a (construction); a proof that multiplicative designs cap at size << B*/poly would refocus on p-specific alternatives
node.notes: The root-difference and antipodal-padding germs are valid. The signed-8-core size discharge is refuted because its padding factor consists of exact e1 collisions; a different construction is required.
